Changes: The unified image scanner extends its existing unchecked-barcode tile-boundary filter to Industrial 2 of 5, for default and explicit-format scans. Both quiet margins must have the background polarity and sufficient width; inverted symbols use their dark background. Full-frame and module decoding retain their behavior, and no minimum payload length is introduced. Tile-margin luminance now uses the same alpha-to-white compositing as decoding, preserving visible quiet zones on transparent backgrounds for Industrial 2 of 5, ITF and Pharmacode.
Scope: Four inverted orientations of the perforated texture are scanned with default formats and an Industrial 2 of 5 hint. Before correction, six of the eight checks fail on returned fragments. Six positive contracts preserve both single-digit payloads: typed scans cover both axes and polarities, and default scans cover normal polarity in both axes. Twelve typed transparent-margin cases cover both image axes and alpha 0/128 for these three formats. Both original payloads are restored in every case; Industrial and ITF return exactly those two.
Limits: These images informed the repair. They establish these regressions and valid short-symbol behavior, not a general false-positive rate. Unfinished format searches remain inconclusive in the unchanged corpus. Default-format scans still miss the inverted single-digit pair, while explicit Industrial hints recover both payloads; this pre-existing recognition gap remains open. The separate full-frame Pharmacode ambiguity remains open: a neighboring 91/123 pair also produces 2079, before and after the repair.

RegressionBefore.Scope: Negative contracts cover four inverted orientations with default and explicit Industrial formats. Default scans fail in two orientations; explicit-format scans fail in all four. Six positive contracts pass, covering normal default/typed and inverted typed scans in both axes. Default inverted single-digit misses are separately retained as a pre-existing gap.
Both original typed tile payloads, alpha 0/128 and both axes, for Industrial 2 of 5, ITF and Pharmacode. Separate Pharmacode full-frame concatenation remains open.

AlphaMargins.Scope: Twelve typed public-scanner tile scans, two axes and transparent or half-transparent black backgrounds across Industrial 2 of 5, ITF and Pharmacode; no deadline. Correct requires both original tile payloads, and exactly those two for Industrial/ITF. Pharmacode's pre-existing extra full-frame concatenation remains an open gap and is retained separately as AdditionalPayloads.
AlphaMargins.Limits: The generated transparent fixtures informed the repair. Pharmacode retains its pre-existing extra combined full-frame payload 2079 from the 91/123 pair. Restoring the two original tile results does not resolve this separate ambiguity.
